title: Ticker
description: A seamless crawl built with data-list. Send UPDATE while it is on air and the custom update hook swaps the headlines without taking the bar off screen.

data.label: Tally
items: Templates are plain HTML, CSS and TypeScript
update() accepts JSON or CasparCG Client XML
Every command runs through one queue, so animations never overlap
npm run build gives you one self-contained file per template
Works over file:// straight from CasparCG's template folder
